deviations_from_wireless: USB only, no battery: no Ebyte E73 (nRF52840) module, no Bluetooth, no Li-Po cell, no charger (MCP73831), no power path (B5819W + SI2301), no power switch, no battery divider, no 32.768 kHz crystal, no antenna keep-out.

Raspberry Pi RP2040 instead of the module, with the minimum circuit of Raspberry Pi's 'Hardware design with RP2040' (the Pico's): 12 MHz crystal ABM8-272-T3 (the one Raspberry Pi qualified) with 2 x 15 pF and 1k in series on XOUT; W25Q128JV QSPI flash (16 MB) with a 10k pull-up on QSPI_SS; 100 nF on each of the six IOVDD pins, on both DVDD, USB_VDD and ADC_AVDD, 1 uF on VREG_VIN and VREG_VOUT; the internal regulator makes the 1.1 V core supply; TESTEN grounded.
USB: hub port 3 goes to the RP2040's USB_DP / USB_DM through 27 ohm series resistors (as on the Pico and in the design guide), instead of the module's D+ / D-.

Programming: the RP2040's boot ROM is a USB drive (RPI-RP2) - no bootloader to flash with an SWD probe. A blank board starts in it; BOOT (SW101, QSPI_SS to GND through 1k) held while plugging the cable enters it again; RESET (SW102) pulls RUN low. The SWD pads stay for debugging.
3.3 V regulator AP2112K-3.3 (the same as the wireless board) fed straight from VBUS: 1 uF in, 1 uF + 10 uF out.
Status LED (red, Caps Lock) on an RP2040 GPIO, through 1k, as on the wireless board.
Test points: SWD (SWCLK, SWDIO, RESET, GND) in one row in front of the RP2040, 3V3 behind it, VBUS; no VBAT / VIN.

Sound card: the supply switch U8 is turned on by VBUS instead of a GPIO (the wireless board has it on only in USB mode; here it always is) and its pull-down is dropped. It still soft-starts the sound card's 5 V: its 17 uF are charged through the switch's controlled rise, not straight from the cable (only ~3 uF sit directly on VBUS). The amplifier's EN delay (1M + 470 nF) runs from VBUS too, and D104 drags EN down with VBUS on unplug.
